name: Tomas Tobé - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Agreement between the European Union and the People’s Republic of Bangladesh on certain aspects of air services
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to a new air travel deal between the European Union and Bangladesh. Right now, airlines from only seven EU countries (Belgium, Denmark, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, France and Slovakia) can fly between those countries and Bangladesh, and only if the airline is owned or controlled by that country or Bangladesh. The new deal lets any EU airline fly those routes. It also adds common EU rules on safety, fuel taxes and competition.

- Any EU airline may fly between Bangladesh and those seven EU countries, if flight rights are available.
- It affects airlines, travellers and the seven countries named; it does not create new flight rights by itself.
- The deal is signed; it enters into force after this approval, and Parliament's President passes the decision on.
